title: Semver Compare
description: Parses a Semantic Version 2.0.0 string and optionally compares it to another version or tests it against a comparator range. Takes version (required), optional other, optional range, and optional loose. Returns validity, canonical version, major/minor/patch, prerelease and build identifiers, and when requested a compare result (-1/0/1) or satisfies boolean. Range syntax is comparator operators (=, ==, !=, >, >=, <, <=), space-separated AND, and || OR. Caret, tilde, x-ranges, and hyphen ranges are rejected. Build metadata is ignored in precedence, matching node-semver. A prerelease version satisfies a range only when some comparator in the matching AND-set shares its major.minor.patch and itself has a prerelease, unless includePrerelease is true.

version.description: Version to parse. A leading v is allowed. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

other.description: Second version. Precedence ignores build metadata.

loose.description: Allow leading zeros and a few loose forms, as in node-semver loose mode.

includePrerelease.description: If true, prerelease versions may satisfy ranges that do not mention a matching prerelease tuple.
